# Scraper de YouTube.com

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [日本語](README.ja.md) · [Español](README.es.md) · [Русский](README.ru.md) · [Deutsch](README.de.md) · [Français](README.fr.md) · **Português (Brasil)** · [한국어](README.ko.md)

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/youtube-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/youtube-scraper.md)

Scraper de exemplo que coleta vídeos, canais, comentários, buscas e vídeos curtos públicos do YouTube.com, escrito em Python com a API de web scraping do [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/). Faz parte do [scrapfly-scrapers](../docs/README.pt-BR.md).

- **Guia:** [How to Scrape YouTube in 2025](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-youtube)
- **Código:** [`youtube.py`](youtube.py) · **Execução de exemplo:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Testes:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Saída de exemplo:** [Channel videos](results/channel_videos.json) · [Channel metadata](results/channels.json) · [Video metadata](results/videos.json) · [Video comments](results/comments.json) · [Shorts' metadata](results/shorts.json) · [Search](results/search.json) · [Transcripts](results/transcripts.json)

## O que ele extrai

- Metadados de vídeos do YouTube
- Comentários de vídeos do YouTube
- Metadados de canais do YouTube
- Vídeos de canais do YouTube
- Busca do YouTube
- Metadados de shorts do YouTube

## Funções

- `scrape_video(ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape video metadata from YouTube videos
- `scrape_comments(video_id, max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scraper comments from a YouTube video
- `scrape_channel(channel_ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape channel metadata from YouTube channel pages
- `scrape_channel_videos(channel_id, sort_by='Latest', max_scrape_pages=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape video metadata from YouTube channel page
- `scrape_search(search_query, max_scrape_pages=None, search_params=None)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape search results from YouTube search query
- `scrape_shorts(ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape metadata from YouTube shorts
- `scrape_transcript(video_ids)` → `List[Dict]`: scrape transcript segments (start and end time in milliseconds and text) of YouTube videos

As funções são `async`: execute-as com `asyncio.run(...)` ou use `await`.

### Exemplo

As entradas são os exemplos de [`run.py`](run.py) (listas longas encurtadas):

```python
import asyncio
import youtube


async def main():
    video = await youtube.scrape_video(ids=["1Y-XvvWlyzk", "muo6I9XY8K4"])
    comments = await youtube.scrape_comments(video_id="FgakZw6K1QQ", max_scrape_pages=3)
    channel = await youtube.scrape_channel(channel_ids=["scrapfly"])
    channel_videos = await youtube.scrape_channel_videos(
        channel_id="statquest",
        sort_by="Latest",
        max_scrape_pages=2,
    )
    search = await youtube.scrape_search(
        search_query="python",
        search_params="EgQIAxAB",
        max_scrape_pages=2,
    )
    shorts = await youtube.scrape_shorts(ids=["rZ2qqtNPSBk"])
    transcript = await youtube.scrape_transcript(video_ids=["x7X9w_GIm1s"])


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Saída

As funções retornam dicionários e listas simples. Campos da saída de exemplo (chaves de primeiro nível do primeiro item):

- [`results/channel_videos.json`](results/channel_videos.json): `videoId`, `title`, `publishedTime`, `viewCount`, `lengthText`, `thumbnails`, `url`
- [`results/channels.json`](results/channels.json): `description`, `url`, `subscriberCount`, `videoCount`, `viewCount`, `joinedDate`, `country`, `links`
- [`results/videos.json`](results/videos.json): `video`, `channel`, `commentContinuationToken`
- [`results/comments.json`](results/comments.json): `comment`, `author`, `stats`
- [`results/shorts.json`](results/shorts.json): `videoId`, `title`, `lengthSeconds`, `channelId`, `isOwnerViewing`, `shortDescription`, `isCrawlable`, `thumbnail`, `allowRatings`, `viewCount`, `author`, `isPrivate`, `isUnpluggedCorpus`, `isLiveContent`, `isTvfilmVideo`
- [`results/search.json`](results/search.json): `id`, `title`, `description`, `publishedTime`, `videoLength`, `viewCount`, `videoBadges`, `channelBadges`, `videoThumbnails`, `channelThumbnails`, `url`
- [`results/transcripts.json`](results/transcripts.json): `videoId`, `startMs`, `endMs`, `text`

## Configurações do Scrapfly

`BASE_CONFIG` em [`youtube.py`](youtube.py) contém as configurações padrão das requisições; veja a [documentação da Scrape API](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: o [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker) do Scrapfly, que contorna proteções anti-bot
- `country` = `"US"`: país do proxy

## Início rápido

Requer Python 3.10+ e [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/youtube-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # em https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # scraping de exemplo, salva a saída em ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # os testes deste scraper
```

Testes: `test_video_scraping`, `test_comment_scraping`, `test_channel_scraping`, `test_channel_videos_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`, `test_shorts_scraping`, `test_transcript_scraping`; para executar um, use `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` e os testes fazem scraping do site real, por isso consomem créditos do Scrapfly.
